hannah_cs: Heads-up — Solstice (pilot) sent consolidated feedback after onboarding week. CS needs product triage so we can lock renewal playbook.

hannah_cs: Short list they pasted: per-route billing split, org-level embeddings export, nightly offline sync for on-prem agents, and a smoother first-run Console flow.

raj_pm: Which of those are blockers for their pilot/renewal?

hannah_cs: Per-route billing and offline sync are blockers; embeddings export is high-value; Console UX is a lower-priority polish. Renewal in 6 weeks and finance is already asking for billing visibility. :rotating_light:

marta_prod: Can CS add one-liners about customer impact (revenue at risk, ops effort saved)?

hannah_cs: Sure: billing -> prevents correct invoicing, finance may delay payment; offline sync -> compliance/legal will not sign off; embeddings export -> saves 8-12 analyst hours/month; UX flow -> extra support tickets and lower onboarding NPS.

jia_eng: Rough engineering ballpark: billing ~2 engineers x 4-6w (billing svc + usage pipeline + flags), offline sync ~3 engineers x 6-8w (packaging + infra), embeddings export ~1 engineer x 1-2w, Console flow ~1 designer + 1 eng x 2-3w.

raj_pm: Prioritize: billing > offline sync > embeddings > console. Any short-term mitigations we can offer to avoid churn?

hannah_cs: We proposed a daily CSV split export for billing as an interim; procurement said it's painful but acceptable for up to 6 weeks if we commit to roadmap. They'll accept that as a stopgap.

triage-bot: Created ticket RD-4580: "Solstice: per-route billing interim export + RFC" assigned to @jia_eng.

jia_eng: I'll add an API-first spike to RD-4580 to avoid console work and try to shave ~2w off the delivery. Will include acceptance criteria.

marta_prod: Please add Impact/Effort on roadmap board: billing Impact=9 Effort=8, offline Impact=8 Effort=9, export Impact=6 Effort=2, console Impact=4 Effort=2.

hannah_cs: I pinged the customer for internal ranking and to confirm CSV interim acceptance. Will paste their ranking when they reply.

hannah_cs: Customer replied: ranking = 1) per-route billing 2) offline sync 3) embeddings export 4) Console flow. They accept interim CSV but want a roadmap commit within 3 weeks. Renewal risk = "elevated" if billing isn't committed.

raj_pm: Actions: hannah -> get written acceptance for CSV; jia -> add API spike and quick plan to RD-4580; marta -> update roadmap board and schedule 30m grooming.

hannah_cs: Will do. Closing thread; will reopen when customer confirms in writing or when RD-4580 has a spike plan.
